title: ChatGPT Recommendation Check
summary: Ask ChatGPT the questions your buyers ask, count how often it recommends you and who it names instead, see which pages it relies on, and get three fixes to test.
outcome: See how often ChatGPT recommends you when buyers ask, who it names instead, and three fixes to test, for about $0.20 a run.
boundary: ChatGPT only: logged-out answers for one country and language. Google AI, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity are not checked. Results are counts from a small sample, never a rank or a single score; no fix is promised to work; nothing is published, changed on your site or sent to anyone.

catalog_tools.purpose: Ask ChatGPT each exact question, logged-out, with web search off for the counted answers and on for the source pass.
Find the business's own page that should answer a buyer question when it isn't linked from the home page.
Open the business's pages and the pages ChatGPT cites before building a fix on them.
Re-read a page once when the first read comes back empty or as navigation only.

inputs: Five of eight buyer questions the agent drafts for you; none names your brand
outputs: A one-screen scorecard: how often ChatGPT mentions, recommends and cites you in 25 buyer answers, in plain English
Whether ChatGPT gets your facts right when asked about you by name (3 answers)
Who ChatGPT names instead and the pages it used, with counts and exact links
Three fixes to test this week: improve your own pages and get onto the pages ChatGPT cites for rivals
A retest date, with receipts and limits in a Details section at the end

cost.model: 33 ChatGPT answers and about 10 page checks, priced per call.
cost.notes: Re-inspect before each run. At 14 October 2026 prices ($0.005600 an answer, $0.003300 a page check, $0.002500 a re-read or search) a check costs about $0.217800 and at most $0.260800 with spare answers, re-reads and searches; stop and ask above $0.50. A weekly re-check costs about $0.20.

approvals: Approve the market, the five ticked questions and the stated maximum before the first paid call
Pause for a server confirmation request, a higher maximum after re-inspection, or any change to the questions or market
A weekly re-check needs the user's yes for the same questions and maximum
No publishing, website changes or contact with third parties
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file or conversation state for the saved check and next week's comparison
